Simple table with header

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Age</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Alice</td><td>30</td></tr></tbody></table>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
```
